_note: C6 (goals/c6-consent-and-data-register.yaml): what the school keeps about a child, why, how long and who sees it, in a parent's words; one entry for each kind of thing kept, naming the tables that hold it (tests/test_data_register.py fails if a table holding a child's data is in no entry). A draft for a lawyer to check against India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 before any parent reads it. How long anything is kept after a child leaves is for the school to decide; until it does, the words say so.

data_register.what: Your child's name, and the languages spoken at home.
data_register.why: So your child's educators know whose work is whose. The name is kept apart from everything else, and is never sent to the computer service that reads handwriting.
data_register.how_long: While your child is at the school. How long after they leave is for the school to decide.
data_register.who_sees: Your child's educators and the school's coordinator.

data_register.what: Your child's class, section and roll number.
data_register.why: So your child's papers reach them, and their work is shown with their class.
data_register.how_long: While your child is at the school. How long after they leave is for the school to decide.
data_register.who_sees: Your child's educators and the school's coordinator.

data_register.what: The papers your child is given and writes on, and the scans or photos of them.
data_register.why: So each answer can be read and checked, and the next paper fits what your child is ready for.
data_register.how_long: While your child is at the school. How long after they leave is for the school to decide.
data_register.who_sees: Your child's educators and the school's coordinator. A computer service reads the handwriting on a scan; it is given the picture of the page, never your child's name.

data_register.what: Each of your child's answers as it was read, how it was marked, and any correction an educator made.
data_register.why: So marking is checked by a person, and a mistake in reading is put right rather than counted against your child.
data_register.how_long: While your child is at the school. How long after they leave is for the school to decide.
data_register.who_sees: Your child's educators and the school's coordinator.

data_register.what: What your child's answers, and what an educator saw, show they can do, skill by skill.
data_register.why: So your child's educators know what to teach next. A record is kept as it was written; a correction is added beside it, never in its place.
data_register.how_long: While your child is at the school. How long after they leave is for the school to decide.
data_register.who_sees: Your child's educators and the school's coordinator.

data_register.what: The reports written for you about your child, and who approved them.
data_register.why: So what reaches you has been read and approved by two people at the school.
data_register.how_long: While your child is at the school. How long after they leave is for the school to decide.
data_register.who_sees: You, your child's educators and the school's coordinator.

data_register.what: Which member of staff opened your child's page, and when.
data_register.why: So the school can see who has looked at your child's information.
data_register.how_long: While your child is at the school. How long after they leave is for the school to decide.

data_register.what: Whether you agreed to this register, or withdrew, when, and who at the school recorded it.
data_register.why: So the school keeps only what you agreed to, and can show it.
data_register.how_long: While your child is at the school, and as long as the school keeps anything else on this list.
